dynakillers.Aréna Dynakillers. Pohyb šipkami, bomba: Dynakillers arena. Move with the arrow keys and drop bombs with Space.
AN ATARI CLASSIC. NOW IN YOUR BROWSER.
Blast your way through. Collect power-ups.
Above all, get clear of your own bombs.
dynakillers.Proboř si cestu. Sbírej bonusy. A hlavně: Blast your way through. Collect power-ups. Above all, get clear of your own bombs.
Choose a mode and enter the arena.
dynakillers.Režim proti počítači je doplněk webové v: Computer opponents are an addition to the web version.
dynakillers.Podporuje také gamepady. Stiskni tlačítk: Gamepads are supported too. Press a button on your controller.
dynakillers.Výbuch zastaví zeď i první kámen. Bomba: Walls and the first boulder stop a blast. One bomb can set off another.
dynakillers.Aréna počká. Vrať se, až budeš připraven: The arena can wait. Come back when you are ready.
A draw. Nobody scores this time.
dynakillers.Novou sestavu nastavíš tlačítkem „Nová h: Use “New game” to change the match settings.
dynakillers.Výbuchy jsou nebezpečné pro všechny hráč: Explosions are dangerous to every player.
Set up your match in the settings panel.
dynakillers.Lokální souboj. Všichni hráči hrají na t: Local multiplayer. Everyone plays on this computer.
dynakillers.Gamepad připojen. Směrový kříž / páčka +: Gamepad connected. D-pad / stick + A to drop a bomb.

international-karate.International Karate pro Atari XL/XE v n: International Karate for Atari XL/XE in HTML5. Original animations, Rob Hubbard's music, computer opponents and two-player matches.
international-karate.Bílý a červený karatista. Ovládání je uv: White and red karate fighters. Controls are listed below the game.
Two fighters. Two points to win.
international-karate.Šipky + mezerník. Směr drž až do provede: Arrow keys + Space. Hold the direction until the move is performed.
Two players can use two gamepads.
international-karate.Tabulka platí pro postavu otočenou dopra: The guide shows a fighter facing right; moves are mirrored when facing left. Hold an attack until it connects, then release before attacking again. Retreat blocks high attacks; jump to avoid a sweep.
international-karate.. Čistý zásah přidá celý bod, okrajový p: . A clean hit scores a full point; a glancing hit scores half a point. The first to
wins; if time runs out, the higher score wins.
international-karate.V turnaji prohra znamená konec. Každé tř: One loss ends the tournament. Every three wins bring a bonus: tile breaking or dodging weapons. Higher scores earn higher belts.
international-karate.Počkej na soupeřův výpad, ustup a vrať m: Wait for your opponent to attack, step back, then land a precise counter.
international-karate.První hratelná webová verze. Původní gra: First playable web version. Original graphics, move sequences and music; combat logic and computer opponents are newly written.
Score {score} · matches won {wins}. Try another run towards the black belt.
Wait for GO, then press Space / FIRE.
High weapon: down. Low weapon: up.

river-raid.River Raid z Atari XL/XE jako samostatná: River Raid for Atari XL/XE as a standalone HTML5 game. The original river, aircraft and sounds. Fly, refuel and blast through the bridge.
river-raid.LETOVÝ PLÁN / ŘEKA BEZ NÁVRATU: FLIGHT PLAN / RIVER OF NO RETURN
Stay on course. Watch your fuel.
Into a stream of enemies, against the river's flow.
river-raid.Herní řeka River Raid. Šipky řídí letadl: River Raid game screen. Arrow keys steer the aircraft and control speed. Space fires.
Four aircraft. Bridges, ships and helicopters.
river-raid.Zpomal nad FUEL a vydrž o jeden most dál: Slow down over FUEL and make it one bridge further.
Four aircraft. Bridges, ships and helicopters. Slow down over FUEL and make it one bridge further.
river-raid.Vlevo a vpravo řídíš. Nahoru přidáš rych: Steer left and right. Up speeds up; down slows down. Slow down over a FUEL depot.
river-raid.Dva piloti · střídání po ztrátě: Two pilots · alternate after losing an aircraft
river-raid.Každý pilot má čtyři letadla. Další získ: Each pilot has four aircraft. Earn another for every 10,000 points.
river-raid.Držením FIRE střílíš opakovaně. Palivo u: Hold FIRE to shoot repeatedly. Fuel runs down even at low speed. Switching windows pauses the game.
river-raid.Tankuj průletem nad FUEL. Nádrž můžeš ta: Refuel by flying over FUEL. You can destroy the depot too, but the next one may be far away.
An empty tank on a tight bend.
river-raid.Původní bitmapy, řeka a zvuky Atari. Nov: The original Atari bitmaps, river and sounds. A web game that runs right in your browser. Keyboard, gamepad and touch controls — just take off.
river-raid.Pilot {pilot}: {lives} letadla, {score}: Pilot {pilot}: {lives} aircraft, {score} points. Arrow keys control direction and speed.
river-raid.Pauza. Pokračuj tlačítkem nebo klávesou: Paused. Press Resume or P to continue.
river-raid.Tankování. Drž kurz nad nádrží; pomalejš: Refuelling. Stay over the depot; a slower pass gives you more fuel.
river-raid.Palivo pod čtvrtinou! Najdi FUEL, zpomal: Less than a quarter tank! Find FUEL, slow down and stop firing over the depot.
river-raid.Pilot {pilot} · {lives} letadla · Prostř: Pilot {pilot} · {lives} aircraft · Blast through the bridge and stay over water.
Hit the bank or an island.

hero.H.E.R.O. z Atari XL/XE v nativní HTML5 v: H.E.R.O. for Atari XL/XE in native HTML5. A propeller pack, a laser and dynamite. Find trapped miners in the original caves.
A propeller on your back, dynamite on your belt.
And a power supply that will not wait.
hero.H.E.R.O. Šipky řídí pohyb a vrtulku. Dol: H.E.R.O. Arrow keys control movement and the propeller. Down places dynamite; Space fires.
hero.Proleť jeskyní, odpal překážky a najdi h: Fly through the cave, blast obstacles and find the miner. Watch your power — the route leads ever deeper.
hero.Nahoru roztočí vrtulku. Vlevo a vpravo l: Up starts the propeller. Left and right move you on foot or in flight. Place dynamite while standing and move away from the blast.
hero.Čtyři životy a šest náloží na misi. Za k: Four lives and six charges per mission. Every 20,000 points earn an extra life, up to seven.
hero.Laser zneškodní nepřátele. Pozor na lamp: The laser defeats enemies. Watch the lamps: shooting one darkens the room. WASD and gamepads are also supported.
hero.Výbuch otevře cestu skrz zeď. Laser ji p: An explosion opens a route through a wall. The laser burns through it gradually. Hot walls, water and moving obstacles lie ahead.
hero.Zbylá energie a nálože se po záchraně pr: Remaining power and charges become points after a rescue. Each new mission replenishes your equipment.
hero.Původní jeskyně, bitmapy a pravidla Atar: Original Atari caves, bitmaps and rules in standalone JavaScript. Twenty missions and further expeditions into the depths. Keyboard, gamepad and touch controls — just start the propeller.
hero.Zvuk se nepodařilo spustit. Hra je připr: Audio could not be started. The game is ready; try the Sound button.
hero.Až budeš připravený, pokračuj v záchraně: Continue the rescue when you are ready.
A little propeller. A big rescue.
hero.Vyber obtížnost a vyraz do jeskyní. Horn: Choose a difficulty and head into the caves. A miner waits at the end of each mission.
hero.Dosáhl jsi nejvyššího skóre. Výprava je: You reached the maximum score. The expedition is complete.
hero.Zachránil ses až do mise {level}. Skóre:: You made it to mission {level}. Score: {score}.

boulder-dash.Boulder Dash z Atari XL/XE v nativní HTM: Boulder Dash for Atari XL/XE in native HTML5. Rockford, falling boulders, diamonds and the original caves. Play right in your browser.
Collect the diamonds and find the exit.
Boulder Dash. Arrow keys move Rockford. Hold Space and a direction to collect without moving.
boulder-dash.Prokopej cestu k diamantům a odemkni výc: Dig your way to the diamonds and unlock the exit. Boulders fall, butterflies bring treasure — and time is running out.
boulder-dash.Šipkami prokopáváš cestu. Podrž FIRE a s: Dig with the arrow keys. Hold FIRE and a direction to collect an adjacent diamond or dirt without moving.
boulder-dash.Tři životy. Šestnáct jeskyní, čtyři mezi: Three lives. Sixteen caves, four intermissions and five difficulty levels. Two players alternate after a failed attempt.
boulder-dash.Funguje také WASD a gamepad. Při dvou ov: WASD and gamepads work too. With separate controls, player two uses IJKL + right Shift or a second gamepad.
boulder-dash.NECH PRACOVAT KAMENY: LET THE BOULDERS DO THE WORK
boulder-dash.Kameny se kutálejí z oblých překážek. Zá: Boulders roll off rounded obstacles. Hitting a butterfly turns its surroundings into diamonds. The amoeba needs room — and the magic wall turns boulders into diamonds.
boulder-dash.Po nasbírání potřebného počtu se otevře: Collect the required number to open the exit. Remaining time becomes points. You do not lose a life in an intermission.
As long as this boulder stays put.
boulder-dash.Původní jeskyně, bitmapy, animace a melo: The original Atari caves, bitmaps, animations and music in standalone JavaScript. You will have to find your own way to the exit.
boulder-dash.Jeskyně zdolána. Stiskni FIRE nebo Enter: Cave completed. Press FIRE or Enter to continue.
boulder-dash.Na řadě je hráč {player}. Stiskni FIRE n: Player {player}'s turn. Press FIRE or Enter to try again.
boulder-dash.Nasbírej diamanty a najdi blikající vých: Collect diamonds and find the flashing exit. FIRE + direction collects without moving. Escape gives up the cave.
boulder-dash.Skóre {score}. Další cesta k diamantům u: Score {score}. Another route to the diamonds is waiting.
boulder-dash.Pauza. P nebo tlačítko Pokračovat tě vrá: Paused. Press P or Resume to return to the game.

archon.Archon z Atari v nové HTML5 verzi. Světl: Atari's Archon in HTML5. Light against Dark, board moves, spells and arena battles with the original graphics and sound.
archon.Deska Archonu. Klikni na figuru a cílové: Archon board. Click a piece and its destination, or use the arrow keys and Space.
Or defeat the entire opposing army.
Choose a mode and start playing.
archon.Spolehlivý bojovník zblízka. Ke střelci: A reliable close-range fighter. It must get within reach of ranged opponents.
archon.Světlé pole zvýhodňuje Světlo, tmavé Stí: Light squares favour Light; dark squares favour Dark.
archon.Každé jednou za hru. Kouzlí živý a volný: Each can be used once per game. A living, free mage casts spells; casting replaces a move.
archon.Koho chceš vrátit?: Who do you want to bring back?
archon.Magické body chrání před kouzly. Každé p: Power points protect against spells. Each spell used removes one point from the defence of your home power point.
archon.Klikni na vlastní figuru a pak na zvýraz: Click one of your pieces, then a highlighted square. Or move the cursor with the arrow keys and confirm with
archon.. Pozemní figury nesmějí přes jiné figur: . Ground pieces cannot pass through other pieces; flying pieces can pass over them.
archon.Útok na nepřítele otevře arénu. Barva na: Attacking an enemy opens the arena. The attacked square's colour grants temporary health to the corresponding side.
archon.V sólové hře vždy ovládáš svou stranu ši: In solo play, always control your side with the arrow keys and Space. Hold a direction together with FIRE to attack. The fighter stands still while aiming; FIRE alone triggers the Phoenix's or Banshee's area attack. A sound signals that the weapon is recharged.
archon.Po tahu obou stran se mění proměnlivá po: Variable squares change after both sides have moved. A power point heals its occupant by one health point per full round. The peak of Light or Dark heals that side's entire army.
archon.Vítězí všech pět bodů, vyřazení armády n: Win by holding all five points, eliminating the enemy army or imprisoning its last piece.
archon.Podporované jsou i standardní gamepady a: Standard gamepads and touch controls are supported too. Switching windows pauses the game.
archon.Nativní webová verze s původní grafikou: Native web version with the original graphics and sound. NTSC timing · Light and Dark · One or two players.
archon.Velmi rychlá střela a pohyb po zemi. Vyu: A very fast projectile and ground movement. Make use of the long range.
archon.Teleportuje se na tři pole a sesílá sedm: Teleports up to three squares and casts seven single-use spells.
archon.Šíp a tři pole po zemi. Drž si od soupeř: A bow and three squares of ground movement. Keep your distance.
archon.Odolný, ale pomalý. Těžký kámen má dlouh: Tough but slow. Its heavy boulder takes a long time to reload.
Flies over pieces and fights with a thrown spear.
archon.Létající bojovník s vysokou odolností a: A tough flying fighter with a powerful blast of air.
archon.Při ohnivém výbuchu stojí a je nezranite: Stands still and is invulnerable during its fiery burst. It needs to get close.
Recharges quickly but attacks only at close range.
archon.Silný, velmi rychlý paprsek. Pozemní poh: A powerful, very fast beam. Ground movement is limited by the route.
archon.Teleportuje se na tři pole a ovládá sedm: Teleports up to three squares and commands seven Dark spells.
archon.Mnoho životů a těžká střela, pohyb je po: Lots of health and a heavy projectile, but slow movement. It has no special regeneration.
Takes its opponent's form and weapon in the arena. Survived wounds heal afterwards.
archon.Nejsilnější odolnost a ničivá střela. Dl: The toughest fighter with a devastating projectile. Takes a long time to recharge.
Deals continuous damage with a broad scream. It can move after FIRE is released.
archon.Útočí zblízka, dobíjí rychle. Ke střelci: Attacks at close range and recharges quickly. It needs to reach ranged opponents.
archon.Dočasně přivolaná bytost. Po jedné bitvě: A temporarily summoned creature. Disappears after one battle.
Temporarily summoned fire with a fast attack.
archon.Velmi odolný zemní elementál, jeho pohyb: A very tough earth elemental with slower movement.
archon.Vodní elementál s odolností a silnou stř: A tough water elemental with a powerful projectile.
archon.Přesune vlastní neuvězněnou figuru kamko: Moves one of your free pieces anywhere outside the power points; it can attack an enemy.
archon.Obnoví základní životy vybrané figury mi: Restores the selected piece's base health outside the power points.
archon.Obrátí tok času. Na vrcholu světla či tm: Reverses the flow of time. At the peak of Light or Dark, it jumps to the opposite peak.
archon.Prohodí dvě neuvězněné figury mimo magic: Exchanges two free pieces outside the power points.
archon.Náhodný elementál napadne nepřítele mimo: A random elemental attacks an enemy outside a power point. It disappears after the battle.
archon.Vrátí padlou vlastní figuru na volné pol: Returns one of your fallen pieces to an empty square beside your mage.
archon.Znehybní nepřítele do jeho příznivého vr: Immobilises an enemy until its favourable peak. An imprisoned piece still defends itself.
archon.Deska i aréna počkají. Pokračuj, až bude: The board and arena can wait. Resume when you are ready.
archon.Magický bod · {terrain} pole · Světlo +{: Power point · {terrain} square · Light +{light}, Dark +{dark} health.
First select one of your pieces.
This piece cannot reach that square.

Choose an empty square beside your mage.
Spells do not affect power points.
archon.Vyber volnou vlastní figuru mimo magický: Select one of your free pieces outside a power point.
One of your pieces occupies the destination.
archon.Vyber neuvězněnou figuru mimo magické bo: Select a free piece outside the power points.
archon.Na vrcholu vlastní síly nelze figuru uvě: A piece cannot be imprisoned at its own peak of strength.
archon.Vyber nepřátelskou figuru mimo magický b: Select an enemy piece outside a power point.
First select a fallen piece from the list.
Revive the piece on an empty square beside your mage.
The opposing army has been destroyed.
The last enemy piece is imprisoned.
archon.Malé armády se dvanáct kol nesetkaly v b: The small armies have not met in battle for twelve rounds.
The elemental defeated its opponent and disappears.

goonies.The Goonies z Atari XL/XE jako samostatn: The Goonies for Atari XL/XE as a standalone web game. Two friends, eight scenes and the road to One-Eyed Willy's treasure.
goonies.Herní scéna Goonies. Šipkami se pohybuj,: The Goonies game screen. Move with the arrow keys, jump or climb with Up, and switch characters with Space.
goonies.Najdi cestu z domu Fratelliových až na p: Find a route from the Fratellis' house to the pirate ship.
goonies.Jeden drží. Druhý hledá cestu. Spolu se: One holds on. The other finds a way. Together they go further.
goonies.Celá výprava od začátku: The full adventure from the beginning
goonies.Trénink · 2. Jeskyně s klíčem: Practice · 2. The cave with the key
goonies.Ve výpravě musí z každé scény uniknout o: In the full adventure, both characters must escape every scene. Practice ends after the selected room.
goonies.Když přepneš postavu, první zůstane drže: When you switch characters, the first keeps holding the chain or lever. Hold Up and a direction together to jump diagonally.
goonies.Ve dvou: první šipky, druhý: Two players: arrow keys for player one, and for player two
select the character in solo play.
goonies.Přesuň židli pod vstup na půdu. Jeden Go: Move the chair under the attic entrance. One Goonie works the printing press while the other tips the water tank to put out the fireplace.
And every friend has a part to play.
goonies.Od tajného tunelu pod domem přes jeskyně: From the secret tunnel beneath the house, through caves, water traps and the stone organ, all the way to One-Eyed Willy's treasure. Original graphics and sound, with the adventure right in your browser.
goonies.První hratelná webová verze. Původní gra: First playable web version. Original graphics and sound; newly written movement, collisions and puzzle mechanisms.
goonies.Grafiku se nepodařilo načíst. Zkus obnov: The graphics could not be loaded. Try refreshing the page.
goonies.SPOLU AŽ K POKLADU: TOGETHER ALL THE WAY TO TREASURE
goonies.Skóre {score}. Vyber další trénink, nebo: Score {score}. Choose another practice room or the full adventure.
goonies.Skóre {score}. Každá past má řešení. Zku: Score {score}. Every trap has a solution. Try another route.
goonies.Židle pod půdu, peníze z tiskárny a voda: A chair for the attic, money from the press and water for the fireplace. Everyone has a job.
goonies.Přesuň židli k otvoru na půdu. Jeden obs: Move the chair beneath the attic opening. One works the press while the other tips the water to put out the fireplace.
goonies.Židli tlač pod pravý otvor na půdu. Vysk: Push the chair beneath the right-hand attic opening. Jump onto it and climb up to the press. With the other Goonie below, jump right into the tank to tip it over. Once the fire is out, climb down the fireplace and follow the tunnel all the way right. Then bring your friend too.
goonies.Jeden drží rumpál, druhý získá klíč nad: One holds the winch while the other gets the key above the pool.
goonies.Spodní rumpál otevře cestu na plovoucí k: The lower winch opens a route to the floating stone. Jump from it to reach the upper bar and the key.
goonies.Jeden stojí u spodního rumpálu a drží zd: One stands at the lower winch and holds it raised. The other passes the buckets, reaches the floating stone and grabs the upper bar. The key is at its left end. Then both meet at the lower-left door.
goonies.Tři ventily mění proudy vody. Dva správn: Three valves change the flow of water. The correct two must be closed at the same time.
goonies.Jeden Goonie musí držet levý prostřední: One Goonie must hold the middle-left valve, and the other the upper-right valve. The pipe will then burst.
goonies.Spodní pravý ventil pomůže přesměrovat v: The lower-right valve helps redirect the water and get your friend up. Finally, one must stand at the upper-right valve and the other at the middle-left valve. Pressure bursts the right-hand pipe, allowing both into the tunnel behind it.
goonies.Jeden hlídá spodní past. Druhý vede kame: One watches the lower trap. The other guides boulders through three trapdoors.
goonies.Tři správně vedené kameny rozbijí tři pr: Three correctly guided boulders break the three boards in front of the lower-left tunnel.
goonies.Druhého nech na spodním závaží. Za řetěz: Leave the other Goonie on the lower weight. Press Up to hang from a chain. The boulder first drops through the upper trap; on the second floor it must go right, and on the third, left. If you miss the timing, wait for another bounce.
goonies.Lebka a ptačí vejce: The skull and the bird eggs
goonies.Čtyři vejce vytvoří schody u pravého tun: Four eggs form steps beside the right-hand tunnel.
goonies.Jeden tahá za horní pravou kost. Druhý p: One pulls the upper-right bone. The other pushes falling eggs across the bridge to the lower-right corner.
goonies.Na pravé horní misce se odrazíš výš, až: The upper-right spring launches you high enough to reach the bone. Leave one Goonie hanging there while the other pushes eggs to the right. Four eggs stack beneath the raised right-hand exit. Then get the Goonie holding the bone out too.
goonies.Kapky a tlakové desky mění barevné podpě: Drops and pressure plates change the coloured supports. Time every jump.
goonies.Oba překonají barevné podpěry vlevo a z: Both must cross the coloured supports on the left, then descend from the organ along the right-hand ledges to the lower exit.
goonies.Sleduj dopadající kapky. Tři tlakové des: Watch the falling drops. Three pressure plates by the organ determine which platforms hold; a Goonie can stand on them too. The passages by the organ are used from left to right. Both must eventually reach the lower-right tunnel.
goonies.Kost uvolní klec. Z klece dosáhneš na za: The bone releases the cage. From the cage, you can reach the latch below the seesaw.
goonies.Uvolni klec a dostaň jednoho Goonieho na: Release the cage and get one Goonie onto the lower latch. The other presses the unlocked seesaw to drain the pool.
goonies.Zatáhni za horní levou kost, aby klec sp: Pull the upper-left bone to drop the cage. Push it beneath the lower latch and jump up to it. Leave one Goonie hanging while the other presses the seesaw above. The water then drains and the octopus sinks. Press Down to release the upper bar.
goonies.Pirátská loď a poklad: The pirate ship and the treasure
goonies.Páky otevřou průlezy. Sloth pomůže s tru: Levers open the hatches. Sloth helps with the chest and raises the mast.
goonies.Přidržujte páky, aby druhý mohl projít p: Hold the levers so the other Goonie can pass through the hatches. Push the upper chest to the right and get both Goonies to the treasure.
goonies.Když jeden drží páku, druhý může průleze: While one holds a lever, the other can pass through the hatch. Moving the chest spills coins that distract Mama Fratelli. The smaller Goonie stands on the mast arm while Sloth holds its lift at the middle mechanism. Both must meet beside the chest at the top.
goonies.Pozor na past. Zkus pohyb jinak načasova: Watch the trap. Try changing your timing.
goonies.Klíč je váš. Oba se vraťte k levým dolní: You have the key. Both return to the lower-left door.
The water in the middle chamber is dangerous.
goonies.Vědro tě přimáčklo. Počkej na jeho zdvih: The bucket crushed you. Wait for it to rise.
goonies.Oba ventily jsou zavřené. Tlak roztrhl p: Both valves are closed. The pressure burst the pipe!
Watch the water spraying from the pipe.
Watch the water released by the Fratellis.
goonies.Voda dole je příliš hluboká. Použij plov: The water below is too deep. Use the floating steps.
goonies.Klec se uvolnila. Posuň ji pod spodní za: The cage is free. Push it beneath the lower latch.
goonies.Voda odtéká a chobotnice klesá. Oba do p: The water is draining and the octopus is sinking. Both head for the right-hand tunnel!
goonies.Chobotnice hlídá cestu. Nejdřív vypusť j: The octopus guards the way. Drain its pool first.
goonies.Mince odlákaly Fratelliovou. Přiveď oba: The coins distracted Mama Fratelli. Bring both Goonies to the treasure.
Watch the sea beyond the ship.
goonies.Fratelliová tě chytila. Sloth musí nejdř: Mama Fratelli caught you. Sloth must distract her first.
goonies.Vejce se vylíhlo. Příště ho pošli dolů v: The egg hatched. Send it down in time next time.
goonies.Pozor na propast. Zkus to znovu společně: Watch the pit. Try again together.
goonies.Židle je posunutá. Pod otvorem na půdu j: The chair has moved. Use it as a step beneath the attic opening.
